dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, we'd love you to join our weekend camp next month.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, wiːd ˈlʌv juː tə ˈdʒɔɪn aʊr ˈwiːkɛnd ˈkæmp ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? I'd love to! But I usually work on weekends.
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? aɪd ˈlʌv ˈtuː! bʌt aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ˈwɜːrk ɑːn ˈwiːkɛndz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Oh, I see. Then don't worry about it.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, aɪ ˈsiː. ˈðɛn ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri əˈbaʊt ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I'll ask my manager for the weekend off. Teaching kids is more important.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪl ˈæsk maɪ ˈmænɪdʒər fər ðə ˈwiːkɛnd ˈɔːf. ˈtiːtʃɪŋ ˈkɪdz ɪz ˈmɔːr ɪmˈpɔːrtənt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's very kind of you to give up your weekend. We really appreciate it.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈvɛri ˈkaɪnd əv juː tə ˈɡɪv ˈʌp jʊr ˈwiːkɛnd. wiː ˈriːli əˈpriːʃieɪt ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's nice of you to say that. But I really want to make a difference.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈnaɪs əv juː tə ˈseɪ ˈðæt. bʌt aɪ ˈriːli ˈwɑːnt tə ˈmeɪk ə ˈdɪfrəns.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You will. Some of our volunteers started with community service for school and never stopped.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈwɪl. sʌm əv aʊr ˌvɑːlənˈtɪrz ˈstɑːrtɪd wɪð kəˈmjuːnəti ˌsɜːrvɪs fər ˈskuːl ənd ˈnɛvər ˈstɑːpt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Why did they keep coming back?
dialogue.reading: ˈwaɪ dɪd ðeɪ ˈkiːp ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈbæk?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: They say it's the most rewarding thing they've ever done.
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ ˈseɪ ɪts ðə ˈmoʊst rɪˈwɔːrdɪŋ ˈθɪŋ ðeɪv ˈɛvər ˈdʌn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I believe it. In your photos, the volunteers look very caring.
dialogue.reading: aɪ bɪˈliːv ɪt. ɪn jʊr ˈfoʊtoʊz, ðə ˌvɑːlənˈtɪrz ˈlʊk ˈvɛri ˈkɛrɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: They are. And it was smart of you to bring your old English books for the kids!
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ ˈɑːr. ənd ɪt wʌz ˈsmɑːrt əv juː tə ˈbrɪŋ jʊr ˈoʊld ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈbʊks fər ðə ˈkɪdz!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: They were just sitting on my shelf. It's good to share.
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ wɜːr ˈdʒʌst ˈsɪtɪŋ ɑːn maɪ ˈʃɛlf. ɪts ˈɡʊd tə ˈʃɛr.
